symbols.name: real argument
symbols.meaning: The real number whose floor is taken.
symbols.quote: The floor $\lfloor\xi\rfloor$ of a real number $\xi$ is the greatest integer not greater than $\xi$.

symbols.name: floor
symbols.meaning: The greatest integer not greater than the real number $\xi$.
symbols.quote: The floor $\lfloor\xi\rfloor$ of a real number $\xi$ is the greatest integer not greater than $\xi$.

relations.quote: Every value of the floor function is an [integer](integer.md), so the floor function takes values in the integers.
